39457-my-mission-to-london-1912-1914.creator: Unknown
39457-my-mission-to-london-1912-1914.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The present Prince, after serving in the Prussian army, in which he holds the rank of Major, entered the diplomatic service. He was in 1885 for a short time attached to the German Embassy in London, and afterwards became Councillor of Embassy in Vienna. From 1899 to 1904 he was employed in the German Foreign Office, and received the rank and title of Minister Plenipotentiary.

7688-lucretia-volume-04.title: Lucretia Volume 04
7688-lucretia-volume-04.creator: Unknown
7688-lucretia-volume-04.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It is Vernon's widow who walks alone in the stately terrace; sad still, for she loved well the choice of her youth, and she misses yet the children in the grave. From the date of Vernon's death, she wore mourning without and within; and the sorrows that came later broke more the bruised reed,--sad still, but resigned.

arxiv-2111-04365.title: Bounded and unbounded cohomology of homeomorphism and diffeomorphism groups
arxiv-2111-04365.creator: Nicolas Monod, Sam Nariman
arxiv-2111-04365.description: Abstract . We determine the bounded cohomology of the group of homeomorphisms of certain low-dimensional manifolds. In particular, for the group of orientation-preserving homeomorphisms of the circle and of the closed 2-disc, it is isomorphic to the polynomial ring generated by the bounded Euler class.

arxiv-2112-05354.title: Observation and control of collective spin-wave mode-hybridisation in chevron arrays and square, staircase and brickwork artificial spin ices
arxiv-2112-05354.creator: T. Dion, J. C. Gartside, A. Vanstone, K. D. Stenning, D. M. Arroo, H. Kurebayashi, W. R. Branford
arxiv-2112-05354.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by T. Dion, J. C. Gartside, A. Vanstone, K. D. Stenning, D. M. Arroo, H. Kurebayashi, W. R. Branford. Dipolar magnon-magnon coupling has long been predicted in nano-patterned artificial spin systems. However, observation of such phenomena and related collective spin-wave signatures have until recently proved elusive or limited to low-power edge-modes which are difficult to measure experimentally.

arxiv-2208-06906.title: Limits of an AI program for solving college math problems
arxiv-2208-06906.creator: Ernest Davis
arxiv-2208-06906.description: Abstract Drori et al. (2022) report that “A neural network solves, explains, and generates university math problems by program synthesis and few-shot learning at human level … [It] automatically answers 81% of university-level mathematics problems.” The system they describe is indeed impressive; however, the above description is very much overstated.

arxiv-2304-01843.title: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces: Interplay of Unit-Cell- and Surface-Level Design and Performance under Quantifiable Benchmarks
arxiv-2304-01843.creator: Ammar Rafique, Naveed Ul Hassan, , Muhammad Zubair, , Ijaz Haider Naqvi, Muhammad Qasim Mehmood, Chau Yuen, , Marco Di Renzo, , and Mérouane Debbah
arxiv-2304-01843.description: Abstract The ability of reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) to produce complex radiation patterns in the far-field is determined by various factors, such as the unit-cell’s size, shape, spatial arrangement, tuning mechanism, the communication and control circuitry’s complexity, and the illuminating source’s type (point/planewave).

arxiv-2305-09781.title: SpecInfer: Accelerating Large Language Model Serving with Tree-based Speculative Inference and Verification Conference: 29th ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems, Volume 3; April 27-May 1, 2024; La Jolla, CA, USA 29th ACM International
arxiv-2305-09781.creator: Xupeng Miao, Gabriele Oliaro, Zhihao Zhang, Xinhao Cheng, Zeyu Wang, Zhengxin Zhang, Rae Ying Yee Wong, Alan Zhu, Lijie Yang, Xiaoxiang Shi, Chunan Shi, Zhuoming Chen, Daiyaan Arfeen, Reyna Abhyankar, Zhihao Jia
arxiv-2305-09781.description: Abstract . This paper introduces SpecInfer, a system that accelerates generative large language model (LLM) serving with tree-based speculative inference and verification. The key idea behind SpecInfer is leveraging small speculative models to predict the LLM’s outputs; the predictions are organized as a token tree, whose nodes each represent a candidate token sequence.

arxiv-2311-04518.title: Towards Democratizing AI: A Comparative Analysis of AI-as-a-Service Platforms and the Open Space for Machine Learning Approach
arxiv-2311-04518.creator: Dennis Rall, Bernhard Bauer, Thomas Fraunholz
arxiv-2311-04518.description: Abstract Recent AI research has significantly reduced the barriers to apply AI, but the process of setting up the necessary tools and frameworks can still be a challenge. While AI-as-a-Service platforms have emerged to simplify the training and deployment of AI models, they still fall short of achieving true democratization of AI.

arxiv-2312-03413.title: Approximating Solutions to the Knapsack Problem using the Lagrangian Dual Framework
arxiv-2312-03413.creator: Mitchell Keegan, Mahdi Abolghasemi
arxiv-2312-03413.description: Abstract The Knapsack Problem is a classic problem in combinatorial optimisation. Solving these problems may be computationally expensive. Recent years have seen a growing interest in the use of deep learning methods to approximate the solutions to such problems. A core problem is how to enforce or encourage constraint satisfaction in predicted solutions.

arxiv-2508-10810.title: Sampling theorems for inverse problems on Riemannian manifolds
arxiv-2508-10810.creator: G. S. Alberti 1, E. De Vito 1, B. Gariboldi 2, G. Gigante 2
arxiv-2508-10810.description: Abstract . We consider inverse problems consisting of the reconstruction of an unknown signal f f from noisy measurements y = F ​ f + noise y=Ff+\text{noise} , where F ​ f Ff is a function on a Riemannian manifold without boundary ℳ \mathcal{M} .

arxiv-2511-04509.title: Triviality vs perturbation theory: an analysis for mean-field φ 4 \varphi^{4} -theory in four dimensions
arxiv-2511-04509.creator: Christoph KOPPER , Pierre WANG
arxiv-2511-04509.description: Abstract We have constructed the mean-field trivial solution of the φ 4 \varphi^{4} theory O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) model in four dimensions in [ 24 ] using the flow equations of the renormalization group. Here we establish a relation between the trivial solutions introduced in [ 24 , 26 ] and perturbation theory.

arxiv-2512-15481.title: GenAI-enabled Residual Motion Estimation for Energy-Efficient Semantic Video Communication
arxiv-2512-15481.creator: Shavbo Salehi 1 , Student Member, IEEE , Pedro Enrique Iturria-Rivera 2 , Medhat Elsayed 2 , Majid Bavand 2 , Yigit Ozcan 2 , Melike Erol-Kantarci 1 , Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2512-15481.description: Abstract Semantic communication addresses the limitations of the Shannon paradigm by focusing on transmitting meaning rather than exact representations, thereby reducing unnecessary resource consumption. This is particularly beneficial for video, which dominates network traffic and demands high bandwidth and power, making semantic approaches ideal for conserving resources while maintaining quality.

arxiv-2601-13839.title: DisasterVQA: A Visual Question Answering Benchmark Dataset for Disaster Scenes
arxiv-2601-13839.creator: Aisha Al-Mohannadi, Ayisha Firoz, Yin Yang Muhammad Imran Ferda Ofli
arxiv-2601-13839.description: Abstract Social media imagery provides a low-latency source of situational information during natural and human-induced disasters, enabling rapid damage assessment and response. While Visual Question Answering (VQA) has shown strong performance in general-purpose domains, its suitability for the complex and safety-critical reasoning required in disaster response remains unclear.

arxiv-2602-22223.title: SQaLe : A Large Text-to-SQL Corpus Grounded in Real Schemas
arxiv-2602-22223.creator: Cornelius Wolff, Daniel Gomm, Madelon Hulsebos
arxiv-2602-22223.description: Abstract Advances in large language models have accelerated progress in text-to-SQL, methods for converting natural language queries into valid SQL queries. A key bottleneck for developing generalizable text-to-SQL models is the lack of large-scale datasets with sufficient schema and query complexity, domain coverage, and task diversity.

arxiv-2605-10272.title: DP-LAC: Lightweight Adaptive Clipping for Differentially Private Federated Fine-tuning of Language Models
arxiv-2605-10272.creator: Haaris Mehmood, Jie Xu, Karthikeyan Saravanan, Rogier Van Dalen, Mete Ozay

doe-osti-3379845-scale-up-production-of-.creator: Yilmaz, Sefa, Webb, Daniel, Newport, Jason
doe-osti-3379845-scale-up-production-of-.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. This work investigates the scale-up of pitch precursors for the carbon fiber market using mesophase pitch formulated and produced by Advanced Carbon Products Technologies’ (ACPT’s) patented mesophase pitch processing technology. Through use of its patented process, ACPT developed

europmc-pmc3410874.title: Routine use of microbial whole genome sequencing in diagnostic and public health microbiology.
europmc-pmc3410874.creator: Köser CU, Ellington MJ, Cartwright EJ, Gillespie SH, Brown NM, Farrington M, Holden MT, Dougan G, Bentley SD, Parkhill J, Peacock SJ.

pmc-10610523.title: IL-6 serum level, ARDS, and AKI as risk factors for the COVID-19 infection’s mortality in children
pmc-10610523.creator: Idham Jaya Ganda, Try Kartika Eka Putri, Syarifuddin Rauf, Amiruddin Laompo, Ninny Meutia Pelupessy, Sitti Aizah Lawang, Nadirah Rasyid Ridha, Bahrul Fikri, Muhammad Nasrum Massi
pmc-10610523.description: IntroductionDysregulated immune responses are developed in Coronavirus disease-2019 (COVID-19) and Interleukin-6 (IL-6) levels are reflecting the severity of the clinical presentation. This study aimed to analyze IL-6 serum level, Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS), and Acute Kidney Injury (AKI) as risk factors for mortality in children with COVID-19.

pmc-10643963.title: Study on the prevalence and subtypes of human papillomavirus infection among women in the Xuhui District, Shanghai City, China
pmc-10643963.creator: Han Liu, Chao Zeng, Mingming Jiang, Yue Dai, Minyi Xu, Fangfang Zhou, Yaling Wang, Alessandra Pulliero, Tomasz Sobierajski, Whitney Nesser, Motoki Matsuura, Lei Wang, Jiaying Wu, Muyuan Ji
pmc-10643963.description: BackgroundHuman papillomavirus (HPV) can cause various gynecological diseases, create a long-term inflammatory immune microenvironment, and induce the occurrence of cervical tumors. However, the prevalence of HPV is species-specific in different eras or in different countries and regions. This paper aimed to investigate the characteristics of HPV infection in the Xuhui District, Shanghai City, China.

pmc-10834691.title: The effect of a web-based lifestyle intervention on nutritional status and physical activity on prevention of COVID-19: a randomized controlled trial in women's empowerment
pmc-10834691.creator: Farhad Pourfarzi, Aziz Kamran, Maryam Zare, Jafar Mohammadshahi
pmc-10834691.description: BackgroundHealthy dietary intake and physical activity affect the immune systems. The present study aimed to investigate the effects of a web-based lifestyle intervention on nutritional status, physical activity, and prevention of COVID-19.MethodsThree hundred-three women (30–60 years old), who did not have COVID-19 in the City of Ardabil, participated in this study.

pmc-11399056.title: Methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR) polymorphisms in andrology—a narrative review
pmc-11399056.creator: Zisong Xie, Kaifeng Liu, Shengmin Zhang, Yongzhan Gong, Zihao Wang, Pengjie Lu
pmc-11399056.description: Background and ObjectiveMethylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR) is a key enzyme involved in folate metabolism and one-carbon metabolism. MTHFR gene polymorphism affects enzyme activity. MTHFR gene polymorphism is closely related to many human diseases, such as cardiocerebrovascular diseases, diabetes, neural tube defects (NTDs), tumors, and so on.

pmc-11403964.title: Genomic identification and expression profiling of DMP genes in oat (Avena sativa) elucidate their responsiveness to seed aging
pmc-11403964.creator: Yuan Ma, Huan Liu, Jinglong Wang, Guiqin Zhao, Kuiju Niu, Xiangrui Zhou, Ran Zhang, Ruirui Yao
pmc-11403964.description: BackgroundThe Domain of unknown function 679 membrane protein (DMP) family, which is unique to plants, plays a crucial role in reproductive development, stress response and aging. A comprehensive study was conducted to identify the DMP gene members of oat (Avena sativa) and to investigate their structural features and tissue-specific expression profiles.

pmc-11642312.title: Five-Year Outcomes of Deep Sclerectomy in Pseudoexfoliation Glaucoma Compared to Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma
pmc-11642312.creator: Carlo Fiore, Xiao Shang, Joel-Benjamin Lincke, Nathanael Urs Häner, Martin Sebastian Zinkernagel, Jan Darius Unterlauft, Su-Ho Lim, Daniel Laroche
pmc-11642312.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Objectives: This study aimed to investigate the five-year outcomes of deep sclerectomy (DS) in patients with pseudoexfoliation glaucoma (PEXG) and primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG). Methods: This retrospective, observational, unicentric study analyzed POAG and PEXG patients. Intraocular pressure (IOP), the number of IOP-lowering medications, peripapillary retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL) thickness, the number of postoperative interventions, surgical success rates, and secondary surgery rates were evaluated at baseline and during follow-up appointments. Results: A total of 109 POAG and 153 PEXG eyes were included.

pmc-11679505.title: From Emergence to Evolution: Dynamics of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron Variant in Florida
pmc-11679505.creator: Sobur Ali, Marta Giovanetti, Catherine Johnston, Verónica Urdaneta-Páez, Taj Azarian, Eleonora Cella
pmc-11679505.description: The continual evolution of SARS-CoV-2 has significantly influenced the global response to the COVID-19 pandemic, with the emergence of highly transmissible and immune-evasive variants posing persistent challenges. The Omicron variant, first identified in November 2021, rapidly replaced the Delta variant, becoming the predominant strain worldwide.

pmc-11691253.title: DISABILITY STATUS OF ASIAN OLDER ADULTS IN THE UNITED STATES: FINDINGS FROM THE 2017–2021 AMERICAN COMMUNITY SURVEY
pmc-11691253.creator: Christina Miyawaki, Hoang Nguyen, Kyriakos Markides
pmc-11691253.description: Little information is available on the disability status of the diverse Asian population in the United States (U.S.). In this study we estimate the prevalence of six types of disability in older adults for six major Asian subgroups using the recently released data from the 2017-2021 American Community Survey.

pmc-12528930.title: Mortality rate of stroke and its determinants in Africa: An umbrella review of systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12528930.creator: Addisu Getie, Mihretie Gedfew, Tegene Atamenta Kitaw, Gizachew Yilak, Melaku Bimerew
pmc-12528930.description: IntroductionStroke is a significant clinical condition characterized by inadequate blood flow to the brain, resulting in cerebral function loss and potential death if not promptly treated. In developed countries, stroke incidence is decreasing due to efforts targeting risk factors like high blood pressure and smoking, though aging populations sustain high overall rates.

pmc-13019091.title: Platelet-platelet aggregates at single-event resolution as parameter in health monitoring
pmc-13019091.creator: Sander Bekeschus, Lea Miebach, Broder Poschkamp, Sophie Tarnow, Linus Hübner, Julia van der Linde, Andreas Greinacher, Thomas Thiele, Jan Wesche
pmc-13019091.description: Platelet analysis is crucial to assess in hemostasis, health, and disease. Current diagnostics primarily analyze bulk platelets, limiting the assessment of subtle, single-aggregate changes. We utilize Plateaggrate, a novel neuronal network-driven tool, for scoring platelet-platelet aggregation at single-event resolution using imaging flow cytometry (IFC) of labeled whole blood.

pmc-13389723.title: Exploring ‘MoyaMoya’: a multidisciplinary case study workshop on emotional conflicts in clinical practice
pmc-13389723.creator: Seiichiro Nagai, Tatsuki Ikejiri, Mitsuru Kobayashi
pmc-13389723.description: Objective: This study describes a multidisciplinary, multi-generational case conference focusing on healthcare professionals’ emotional conflicts and moral distress—what we call “moyamoya” in Japanese—in clinical practice.Materials and Methods: Five hybrid conferences were co-organized by Kyoto-Min-Iren and an independent study group. In each session, one anonymized case was presented.

pmc-13657877.title: Toripalimab combined with chemotherapy in the treatment of primary tracheal squamous cell carcinoma: a phase II proof-of-concept study
pmc-13657877.creator: Jie Dai, Xinyun Fang, Xinsheng Zhu, Xinnan Xu, Dongliang Bian, Xiaogang Liu, Wenxin He, Liang Duan, Peng Zhang, Gening Jiang
pmc-13657877.description: BackgroundDespite immunotherapy advancements for many solid cancers, role of first-line immunotherapy for tracheal malignancies is uncertain. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of toripalimab with chemotherapy for initially-unresectable locally-advanced tracheal squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).MethodsSix eligible patients (5 males and 1 female) with tracheal SCC who were initially considered unresectable were enrolled from February 2021 to April 2023.
